The pause box (screens 25, 42, 49) is still at 3 from the critic, short of the 4 his finish line asks for. I'm stopping on it because this was my sixth try, and the rule says to stop after six.

I shipped v32.66 (cw-pausegap). It passed preflight and the gate, including the seed 4242 fingerprint. It changes three things on the pause box:
- **End run:** it now sits one 16px gap under the button stack, instead of floating about 70px below.
- **Focus:** idle buttons show a lime bar and raised fill when focused.
- **Divider:** the line under the title is brighter.

On screen 49 the critic scored 3 and said the new picture is better than the old one. Its remaining P1s:
- **480 dialog:** it reads the 480-wide card as too small. His Q43 calls the pause box a dialog, so I left it.
- **Button stack:** it wants report a problem, feedback and what's new merged into one quiet row. That would be allowed under Q61 (restyle or move, never remove), but I didn't do it.

I didn't re-score 25 and 42, which share the same CSS. The best pause box version is v32.66, pictures in `shots/c-31y-after`. The earlier one is v32.28, in `shots/c-31x-after`.

The settings and keys screens (18, 26–32, 68–75) are at 3 or are scroll and section shots of the same card. His rule 3.51 a says 3 is enough for those.

I logged the change in `notes/ui/changes.md` and the details in `notes/ui/pause-settings.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: pause box screens 25, 42 and 49 are at 3 (target 4) after 6 tries. The best two versions are in my notes.
